title: ½ Penny - Victoria (2nd portrait; 1st type)

obverse.description:
Second wreathed portrait ('Bun Head') of Queen Victoria left, legend around.

Note: varieties exist (see below)
obverse.unabridged_legend: Victoria Dei Gratia Britanniarum Regina Fidei Defensatrix
obverse.lettering_translation: Victoria by the Grace of God Queen of the Britains Defender of the Faith

reverse.description:
Seated figure of Britannia right, trident in left hand, shield bearing the Union flag in right, denomination around, date in exergue, sea behind with lighthouse on left and ship on right.

Note: varieties exist (see below)

comments:
The standard weight of these pieces was 80 to the pound avoirdupois (1/5 ounce or 87½ grains).

Border varieties:

KM#748.1, Sp#3956 (1860) Beaded border;
KM#748.2, Sp#3956 (1860-74) Toothed border.
 

1860 obverse/reverse die varieties:

 

KM#748.1: Obv 1 - 6 berries in wreath, arranged in pairs

                        Obv 1* - as Obv 1 but knot in hair tie removed

                        Rev A - outer circle of round beads

 

KM#748.2: Obv 2 - 14 leaves in wreath, 7 berries

                       Obv 3 - 15 leaves in wreath, 4 berries, leaf midribs raised lines

                       Obv 4 - 15 leaves in wreath, 4 berries, four leaf midribs have 2 incuse lines

                       Rev B - toothed outer circle, tapered lighthouse, small pointed dome

                       Rev C - toothed outer circle, thicker cylindrical lighthouse, rounded dome

 

Common die combinations:

 

Freeman#258 - Obv 1 / Rev A

Freeman#260A - Obv 1* / Rev A

Freeman#261 - Obv 2 / Rev B

Freeman#264 - Obv 2 / Rev C

Freeman#265 - Obv 3 / Rev B

Freeman#266 - Obv 4 / Rev B

Freeman#267 - Obv 4 / Rev C

1874 obverse die varieties (KM#748.2 and KM#754):

 

Variety published in 2004 by I W P Draycott:

 

Regular reverse B has 158 border teeth, the A points directly at a border tooth, legend is close to the border.

The new variant reverse B2 has only 155 border teeth, the A points to right of border tooth, legend is away from border.

This variety is paired with obverse 2.
